items.t: Down 34.7% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why You Should You Buy the Dip in The Metals Company (TMC)
items.sum: The Metals Company (TMC) is technically in oversold territory now, so the heavy selling pressure might have exhausted. This along with strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in raising earnings estimates could lead to a trend reversal for the stock.

items.t: TMC The Metals (TMC) Stock Sees Fair Value Falls After Q3 Sparks Analyst Target Cuts
items.sum: The fair value estimate for TMC the metals has shifted from US$11.20 to US$9.63, which offers an updated anchor point for how some analysts are thinking about the stock. Recent research links this change to more conservative models following the latest Q3 report, with both reduced targets and continued positive ratings shaping a mixed but active debate around execution and valuation.
